name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3331: The second eye found two real defects in v3330, in the module written to prevent exactly the first of them. ONE: why() said UNKNOWN only when BOTH signals were unaskable, so a blind flock plus a process list that cleanly found nothing fell through to return None, which means FREE, with the PRIMARY signal dark. That is the confident-zero shape this module exists to stop, inside the module that stops it. It is now or rather than and, and the sentence NAMES which signal went silent. My own law could never have caught it: its UNKNOWN case stubbed both signals as None and therefore walked the one arrangement that happened to work. TWO: the pre-push probe was pgrep -f on the string hooks/pre-push, which any command line MENTIONING that path satisfies. Opening the hook in an editor would have refused every bump for as long as the editor stayed open, which is an off switch rather than a guard. It now requires an INVOCATION, either an interpreter running the hook or a git push, and four mentions are pinned as negative fixtures alongside three real invocations. The baseline still answers free on a free tree, which is what keeps this from being the strictness that closes the lane. 4 red-proofs PROVEN. A fifth was REMOVED rather than repaired: its anchor was the exact line this fix replaced, and the new proof restores that line as its own sabotage, so the weaker one was superseded rather than merely inconvenient.
